NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the  
authority vested in me by subsection (a)  
of section 262 of the Armed Forces  
Reserve Act of 1952 as added by section  
2 (i) of the Reserve Forces Act of 1955  
(69 Stat. 600), I hereby authorize the  
acceptance of enlistments in units of  
the Ready Reserve of the Army Reserve,  
Marine Corps Reserve, Naval Reserve,  
Coast Guard Reserve, and Air Force Re­
serve pursuant to the provisions of the  
said section 262 of the Armed Forces Re­
serve Act of i952, as added as heretofore  
indicated, under such regulations as the  
Secretary of Defense shall prescribe.”
Dw ight  D. E isenhower
T he W hite  H ouse, -
September 1, 1956.
[P. R. Doc. 56-7163; Piled, Sept. 4, 1956;
10:26 a. m.J
